description:
Find free credits, free tiers, trials and startup, student or open-source programs from AI, GPU, cloud,
        database and developer-tool providers. Results come with who can get each one, what it needs and links.

category.description: ai-api: model APIs (LLM, speech, image, embeddings); gpu-ai-infra: GPUs and inference; cloud; paas: app hosting; data-analytics: databases and analytics; agent-sandbox: sandboxes and browsers for agents; saas: developer tools; oss: for open-source projects.
category.title: Category

eligible_as.description: Groups the person belongs to. Programs open to anyone are always included; other groups' programs are left out. Omit to include every group.
eligible_as.title: Eligible As

exclude_card_required.description: Leave out programs known to ask for a credit card.
exclude_card_required.title: Exclude Card Required

exclude_phone_required.description: Leave out programs known to ask for a phone number.
exclude_phone_required.title: Exclude Phone Required

instant_only.description: Only programs you get right away by signing up, with no application or partner.
instant_only.title: Instant Only

query.description: What the person wants, in plain words or provider names: "OpenAI", "GPU", "postgres hosting", "speech to text". Empty lists the biggest programs.
query.title: Query

name: search_credits

last_checked.description: When the program was last checked against the provider's page (YYYY-MM-DD).
last_checked.title: Last Checked

needs_card.description: True when the provider asks for a credit card at signup; false means not listed.
needs_card.title: Needs Card

needs_phone.description: True when the provider asks for a phone number; false means not listed.
needs_phone.title: Needs Phone

offer.description: What you get, in the provider's terms.
offer.title: Offer

official_page.description: The provider's own page for the program. Show it to the person.
official_page.title: Official Page

worth_up_to_usd.description: The provider's "up to" dollar figure; null when it isn't a dollar amount.
worth_up_to_usd.title: Worth Up To Usd

total_matches.description: How many programs matched before the limit.
total_matches.title: Total Matches

title: Search free credits
